sourceEvidence.claim: The six-organ manifestations list — Renal nephrotic syndrome; Cardiac restrictive cardiomyopathy; GI hepatosplenomegaly; Neurologic dementia and peripheral neuropathy; Musculoskeletal muscle enlargement (eg, macroglossia) and carpal tunnel syndrome; Skin waxy thickening and easy bruising
sourceEvidence.quote:
▘ Renal—nephrotic syndrome.
▘ Cardiac—restrictive cardiomyopathy.
▘ GI—hepatosplenomegaly.
▘ Neurologic—dementia, peripheral
neuropathy.
▘ Musculoskeletal—muscle enlargement
(eg, macroglossia), carpal tunnel syndrome.
▘ Skin—waxy thickening, easy bruising.
